values.task: Add `parseDuration(text)` to a new file src/duration.mjs, the inverse of `formatSeconds`: it turns a duration such as "1h30m", "45s" or "500ms" into a number of seconds. Units are h, m, s and ms, in that order, each at most once; anything else throws a RangeError, and a non-string throws a TypeError. Tests go in tests/duration.test.mjs. A held-out set of cases exists outside this project and settles what this text leaves open; the critic judges against it, and it is not yours to read.
